title: RemoveResponse
description: What was removed, or that a record was forgotten.

folder.description: The folder that was removed, relative to the project.

oneOf.description: A worktree was removed with its branch.

folder.description: The folder that was removed, relative to the project.

branch.description: The worktree's branch, forge/<slice>, which was deleted.

branchAfter.description: The branch was merged, and it was deleted with the worktree.

oneOf.description: A worktree was removed, and its branch was kept at its commit.

folder.description: The folder that was removed, relative to the project.

branch.description: The worktree's branch, forge/<slice>, which still exists.

branchAfter.description: The branch was kept, merged or not, and it did not move.

commit.description: The commit the branch points at, in full, the same before and after.

oneOf.description: The folder was made by this mode but no longer exists, so its record was forgotten.

folder.description: The folder whose record was forgotten, relative to the project.

kind.description: The record was forgotten; nothing was removed.

reason.description: A sentence that says the folder no longer exists, and for a worktree that its branch is kept.
